text: m identical balls are to be placed in n distinct bags. You are given that m >= kn, where k is a natural number >= 1. In how many ways can the balls be placed in the bags if each bag must contain at least k balls?
solution: Give k balls to every bag first, using kn balls. The remaining m-kn identical balls go into n distinct bags with no lower bound, which is stars and bars: C((m-kn)+n-1, n-1).
